stages.name: Introduction
stages.question: Can you walk us through an analytical project where your data insights directly altered a business or product decision?

stages.name: Technical Deep Dive
stages.question: How do you handle severe class imbalance (e.g. 99:1) when training a classification model, and why might accuracy be a deceptive metric?
stages.focus: Algorithm intuition, Precision/Recall, PR-AUC, SMOTE vs Cost-sensitive learning

stages.name: Situational Scenario
stages.question: Your A/B test results indicate a 4% conversion uplift at p=0.04, but the product director points out server latency increased by 120ms. How do you advise leadership?
stages.focus: Trade-off analysis, user experience metrics, risk management

stages.name: Behavioral
stages.question: Tell me about a time when a stakeholder disagreed with your analytical findings. How did you resolve the difference without compromising data integrity?

stages.name: Role-Specific Case
stages.question: Design an end-to-end churn prediction pipeline: from raw database logs to live scoring and alerting. What failure modes do you monitor?
stages.focus: Data engineering, feature drift, model decay, production reliability

sampleFeedback.overallNotes: Strong technical articulation and solid grasp of trade-offs. Recommend practicing STAR structure for situational leadership examples.
